body:
#2541 BUG-1929, last round: REQUEST CHANGES at d0268305a1. Full text is on the PR and in ~/.cache/aida-review-target/2541/verdicts/final-UNRECORDED.txt.

Blocker, reproduced:
- store_hooks.rs:49-64 refuses every store write when .git or any parent directory is group-writable (0775).
- On this host, /home/joe/ai, /home/joe/ai/aida and its .git are all 0775, so merging would brick aida store writes here.
- Two bug_1929 tests FAIL under a 0775 TMPDIR parent and pass after chmod 755. CI misses this because its temp dirs are 0700.
- Fix: accept group-writable directories the user owns (refuse only world-writable or foreign-owned ones), plus a 0775-parent test.

The head also has no completed Build: d0268305a1 was cancelled, and 49e3525e34 failed task_1717 reentrant_writer_hook.

Prior r5-r7 blockers are closed.

My recommendation is a narrow fix-forward on the permission rule only, then a light check, then merge. Do NOT merge as-is.
subject: #2541 final REQUEST CHANGES at d0268305a1: would block all store writes on this host
